name: MultiSelect
intent: Searchable multi-select form field — pick several options from a long list, shown as removable pills.
when: A form field whose value is an array of ids (projects, roles, orgs)
Many options that benefit from type-to-filter
Selected values must stay visible without reopening the dropdown

chooseOver.because: Combobox is single-select and returns a scalar value
Filter is a category-grouped popover with draft/Apply/Clear semantics, not an inline form field
Select is single-value and has no search

extracted: private MultiSelect helper from the AdminPanel template
generalised options from string[] to { value, label, disabled? }

lineage.confidence: unset — promoted from an in-repo template usage
notes: resolves core/Core#180: removes the hand-composed MultiSelect in frontend-2.0-admin

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field as invalid — sets aria-invalid and a destructive border.

props.name: showPills
props.description: Render the selected options as removable pills below the field. Defaults to true.

props.name: maxPills
props.description: Cap on how many pills are drawn before the rest collapse behind a `+N` chip that opens them in a popover. Keeps a long selection from growing the field's height without bound. Default `4`; pass `0` to always show every pill.

props.name: popoverClassName
props.description: Class applied to the popover content. The popover matches the trigger width by default.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element, merging props and behavior.

usage: Use MultiSelect when you need to collect user input or allow users to make selections. This component provides a consistent interaction pattern that users will find familiar and accessible.

MultiSelect should be used within forms or interactive interfaces where user data collection is required. Ensure proper labeling and validation feedback for accessibility. Avoid using this component for read-only or display-only content.

anatomy.description: MultiSelect is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Use semantic props
bestPractices.description: Use the component's built-in props rather than className overrides.

bestPractices.title: Don't override core styles
bestPractices.description: Avoid using className to override the component's fundamental styling.

bestPractices.title: Provide accessible labels
bestPractices.description: Include proper ARIA labels for screen reader users.

bestPractices.title: Don't skip accessibility
bestPractices.description: Never omit accessibility attributes for interactive components.

bestPractices.title: Handle all states
bestPractices.description: Account for loading, error, empty, and success states.

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore edge cases
bestPractices.description: Avoid showing broken UI when data is missing or loading.
